import hashlib
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import update


def _anonymized_email(customer_id):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(str(customer_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    return f'anon-{digest}@example.invalid'


def _anonymize(session, customer_id):
    stmt = (
        update(Customer)
        .where(Customer.id == customer_id)
        .values(
            email=_anonymized_email(customer_id),
            phone=None,
            full_name='Anonymized',
            status='anonymized',
            anonymized_at=datetime.utcnow(),
        )
    )
    return session.execute(stmt).rowcount


def anonymize_customer(session, customer_id):
    changed = _anonymize(session, customer_id)
    session.commit()
    return {'customer_id': customer_id, 'changed': changed}
